author: empire state today
title: Greenberg Traurig attorneys named to Lawdragon 500 Leading Global Cyber Lawyers list
text:
Greenberg Traurig, LLP announced on May 13 that two of its attorneys have been recognized as part of the 2026 Lawdragon Leading Global Cyber Lawyers. The publication highlights individuals who are considered world leaders in privacy, data, security, incident response, and related legal matters.
This recognition is significant as it reflects the increasing importance of cybersecurity and data privacy law in a digital age where organizations face complex challenges regarding technology and information protection.
Samuel Jo, a shareholder in Greenberg Traurig’s Technology Transactions Group based in San Diego, was among those recognized. Jo focuses his practice on complex commercial and licensing agreements as well as technology product and platform development. His work places particular emphasis on emerging technologies such as machine learning and artificial intelligence, quantum computing, aerospace applications, custom Silicon applications, and the Internet of Things.
David A. Zetoony was also named to the list. Zetoony serves as co-chair of the firm’s U.S. Data Privacy & Cybersecurity Practice from Greenberg Traurig’s Denver office. He assists businesses with navigating data privacy and cybersecurity laws from a practical perspective. According to the firm’s announcement, he has helped hundreds of companies establish ongoing privacy programs and has defended corporate practices during investigations by regulatory agencies including the Federal Trade Commission.
The inclusion of these attorneys in Lawdragon’s guide underscores Greenberg Traurig’s role within global conversations about cyber law leadership.
